name: io.github.hyperpolymath/boj-server
title: Bundle of Joy (BoJ) Server
description: Cartridge-based MCP server for DevOps, cloud, database, k8s, and formally verified coordination.

environmentVariables.name: BOJ_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL for the BoJ REST API backend (loads cartridges from boj-server-cartridges).

environmentVariables.name: BOJ_TOOL_SCOPE
environmentVariables.description: Advertised cartridge tool-surface scope ('full', 'core', or CSV of domains like 'core,github,browser').

environmentVariables.name: BOJ_PROTOCOL
environmentVariables.description: Primary protocol for cartridge communication (rest, grpc, graphql).

environmentVariables.name: BOJ_RATE_LIMIT
environmentVariables.description: Maximum number of tool calls permitted per minute.

environmentVariables.name: BOJ_LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Logging verbosity (debug, info, warn, error, silent).

environmentVariables.name: COORD_BACKEND_URL
environmentVariables.description: URL for the local multi-agent coordination bus backend.

environmentVariables.name: GITHUB_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Personal Access Token for GitHub API operations (required for boj_github_* cartridge tools).

environmentVariables.name: GITLAB_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Private Token for GitLab API operations (required for boj_gitlab_* cartridge tools).

environmentVariables.name: GITLAB_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL for the GitLab instance.

environmentVariables.name: OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT
environmentVariables.description: Optional OTLP/HTTP collector endpoint (e.g. http://localhost:4318) for tool-call trace export.
